title: Prove finite reachable alphabets at the FinTM2 interface
head: 9f397bb6ef45fc33bb152915aeae638db1a83d35
body:
PR2411 asks for independent review of the linked theorem's machine/time model. Pinned Mathlib FinTM2 requires a finite input alphabet, control and labels, but does not require every declared internal stack alphabet to be finite. This package kernel-checks the missing interpretation step on isolated source-extracted definitions: one fixed finite list of input symbols and push-callback ranges contains every symbol at every execution prefix. A second theorem bounds primitive constructor work per macro step by a fixed maximum program depth.

The result permits arbitrary dependent internal symbol types. Complete control/label enumeration and admitted initial symbols are explicit premises. It identifies no defect in PR2411, changes no saving, and does not recompile its multiplier. The finite-table interpretation and conventional multitape simulation remain written arguments. Exact correspondence to Mathlib names is source-checked, not elaborated in a full Mathlib import. These boundaries are stated in PROOF.md and README.md.

Validation: fresh Lean/Std 4.34.1 kernel builds of both isolated modules pass four complete transitive axiom reports, using only propext and Quot.sound. A separate AI reviewer inspected the source/model correspondence and independently repeated the kernel workflow with no blocker. The Python3.12 registered hook is explicitly non-kernel: exact extraction/pins, 1,533 finite cases, 24,582 macro prefixes, 116,778 primitive actions, six semantic controls and seven report rejections. Git-free relocation and four real source/semantic/proof/receipt corruptions also pass without overwriting the changed evidence.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fintm2-reachable-alphabet
python3.12 -I -O -B research/fintm2-reachable-alphabet/verify.py --kernel --lean /path/to/lean-4.34.1
```

Canonical main is 0fdd7d82, priority revision4; formal-interface-lemma picker seed a7242c8c0b5dfa08bd7aa11c8af133b1. Only research/fintm2-reachable-alphabet is added. Exact external theorem38ef57bb, Mathlibd13f23b7, license notices, original task, source hashes and open next steps are retained. Current PR2411 head and comments were checked through REST. The final full Discussion refresh failed due GitHub GraphQL rate limits; the package identifies the last complete snapshot and subsequent bounded Curiosity Bot reads rather than claiming complete fresh coverage.

Credit Dan Brown and Kenny Daniel for the external multiplier; Pim Spelier, Daan van Gent, Mario Carneiro and Mathlib contributors for the machine model. New proof and audit by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. No hosted CI, human review, full Mathlib-name kernel bridge, physical compiler or selected-supplier admission is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
